'''2006 World Championship Day 3 Brandon Schele DS Carbon Chamber Testing''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brandon Schele]] at [[2006 World Championship]] (Day 3); the list below is as posted on DeckTech by Brandon "Jedi Genius" Schele (2006-10-31).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35770 Schele's Bounty Deck]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20071014025551/http://decktech.net:80/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35770 Internet Archive]</ref>
